entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Stoke the Core

*Coals brighten inside its body and a hot breath spills between teeth or iron seams.*

Add 1 Fire damage to its next damaging Main Action attack before the end of this turn. Apply it once per target damaged by that attack, using the normal mixed-damage resistance and minimum rules. This grants no extra attack or Burning. Repeated uses do not add more Fire damage.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Weakness:** Cold damage gives it 1 Bane on its next attack before its next turn (1 Boon to that player defense). Does not stack with itself.

**Healing:** Elemental: magical HP healing applies; cannot swallow potions. Printed immunities only.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Small footprints of soot lead out of a cold hearth.

**Purpose:** Find something warm enough to call home.

**Tactics and retreat:** Sting an intruder and retreat behind hot ground.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Offer a safe brazier instead of chasing it through dry grass.

**Habitat:** Hearth; volcanic field · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A useful clue in its hearth; no endless fuel.

**Summoning:** Elemental 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/emberling.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-emberling


**Category:** Elemental · **Role:** Fire skirmisher · **CV:** 8

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 1/2/3

**Reference type:** fire

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.25 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0.1, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=2.000. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [elemental burn](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/elemental-burn.md), [Stoke the Core](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/stoke-the-core.md).

# Elemental Burn

*Heat crawls along the strike, or frost flowers across the skin where it passes.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-elemental-burn


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also applies the printed Burning 1 or Freezing 1; Strong applies that condition at 2. The creature card chooses one condition, not either at use. Burning is fire damage; Freezing is cold damage. Lightning attacks may explicitly leave Burning.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
